
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/rockey627/p/19897604" title="发布于 2026-04-21 22:03">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">AScript函数体系详解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
AScript是一个开源的C#动态脚本解析执行库，提供了完整的函数支持体系：
<ul>
<li>脚本内定义函数 → 定义与调用（与C#语法一致）</li>
<li>外部注入函数 → C# 注入方法</li>
<li>获取函数&nbsp;→&nbsp;返回脚本内定义的函数或者外部注入的函数</li>
<li>生成Lambda&nbsp; → 生成 .NET Expression/Lambda</li>
<li>生成委托 →&nbsp;动态脚本生成可复用委托</li>
</ul>
<h1>一、脚本内定义函数</h1>
<p>脚本内定义函数，使得脚本配置更加灵活，不必依赖于硬编码增加函数。</p>
<h2>标准定义</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int sum(int a, int b) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return a + b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(3, 5);  // 8
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>简化定义（表达式体）</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int sum(int a, int b) =&gt; a + b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(3, 5);  // 8
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>匿名函数</h2>
<p>函数名为“_”下划线。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">var sum = int _(int a, int b) =&gt; a + b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum.Invoke(3, 5);  // 8
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>递归函数</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int fib(int n) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    if (n &lt;= 1) return n;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">fib(10);  // 55
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">9</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">55</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h2>函数重载&nbsp;</h2>
<p>函数名相同，参数个数或参数类型不同。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int sum(int a, int b) =&gt; a + b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int sum(int a, int b, int c) =&gt; a + b + c;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(3, 5) + sum(10, 20, 30);  // 8 + 60=68
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">68</span>, script.Eval(s));</pre>
</div>
<h1>二、注入外部函数</h1>
<h2>&nbsp;脚本上下文中注入函数</h2>
<p>脚本上下文ScriptContext中提供了多个重载AddFunc/AddAction方法：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202604/417450-20260421195826805-605896223.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202604/417450-20260421195716959-496404653.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/417450/202604/417450-20260421195927434-1151043941.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3>&nbsp;注入委托</h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (a, b) =&gt; a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(3,5)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3>注入类静态方法</h3>
<p>注入公开静态方法，不会注入泛型方法。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> script.Context.AddFunc&lt;Math&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Abs(-8)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Math.Abs(-8)</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>注入类实例方法</h3>
<p>注入公开实例方法，不会注入泛型方法。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> random = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Random();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 注入所有公开实例方法</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">script.Context.AddFunc(random);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 只注入Next方法，忽略其他方法
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">script.Context.AddFunc(random, method =&gt; method.Name == "Next" ? method.Name : null);</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> Console.WriteLine(script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Next(1, 10)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> random.Next(1, 10)</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>注入IFunctionEvaluator</h3>
<p>实现<em><strong>IFunctionEvaluator</strong></em>可进行更细微的逻辑控制，非常适合实现参数数量、参数类型、返回值类型不固定的函数；同时如果实现<em><strong>IFunctionBuilder</strong></em>接口，可对函数编译进行控制，提高编译执行模式的性能。</p>
<p>内部的操作符就是实现<em><strong>IFunctionEvaluator</strong></em>和<em><strong>IFunctionBuilder</strong></em>来处理的。</p>
<p>示例：定义幂运算符<strong>**</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 幂运算：2**3=8
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PowerOperator : IFunctionEvaluator, IFunctionBuilder
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> PowerOperator Instance = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PowerOperator();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Build(FunctionBuildArgs e)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> left = e.Args[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Build(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> right = e.Args[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].Build(e.BuildContext, e.ScriptContext, e.Options);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> v1 = Expression.Convert(left, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> v2 = Expression.Convert(right, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> v =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Call(ExpressionUtils.Method_Math_Power, v1, v2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> maxType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScriptUtils.GetMaxType(left.Type, right.Type);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         e.Result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Expression.Convert(v, maxType);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Eval(FunctionEvalArgs e)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e.Args.Count == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> v1 = e.Args[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>].Eval(e.Context, e.Options, e.Control, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> v2 = e.Args[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>].Eval(e.Context, e.Options, e.Control, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> r =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Math.Pow(Convert.ToDouble(v1), Convert.ToDouble(v2));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> maxType =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ScriptUtils.GetMaxType(v1.GetType(), v2.GetType());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            e.SetResult(ScriptUtils.Convert(r, maxType), maxType);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h3>注入CustomFuncton</h3>
<p><em><strong>CustomFunction</strong></em>是由<em><strong>ITreeNode</strong></em>构造的函数，脚本中定义的函数就是解析成<em><strong>CustomFunction</strong></em>加到上下文环境中的。<em><strong>CustomFunction</strong></em>定义如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CustomFunction
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> Name { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>[] ArgNames { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Type[] ArgTypes { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> Type ReturnType { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> ITreeNode Body { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> CustomFunction(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> name, Type returnType, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[] argNames, Type[] argTypes, ITreeNode body);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span> Eval(ScriptContext context, BuildOptions options, EvalControl control, IList&lt;ITreeNode&gt; args, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Type returnType);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> }</pre>
</div>
<h2>顶级上下文中注入函数</h2>
<p>在<em><strong>ScriptContext.Root</strong></em>顶级上下文中注入函数，可实现全局注入函数，并且所有脚本语言共享。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 顶级上下文中注入函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> ScriptContext.Root.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (a, b) =&gt; a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接调用sum函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(3,5)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h2>脚本语言中注入函数</h2>
<p>只在指定脚本语言中有效，其他脚本语言无法调用。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> C#脚本语言中注入函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> CSharpLang.Instance.AddFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, (a, b) =&gt; a +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> b);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 默认C#语言，可以直接调用sum函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果指定其他语言，则报错sum函数不存在
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> script.Context.Langs = new [] { "python3" };</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, script.Eval(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(3,5)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h1>三、获取函数</h1>
<p>&nbsp;只能从<em><strong>ScriptContext</strong></em>上下文中获取函数，如果当前上下文中不存在则从上级搜索，不会搜索<em><strong>ScriptLang</strong></em>中的函数。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> s = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">@"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">int sum(int a, int b) =&gt; a + b;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum(3, 5);  // 8
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">6</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, script.Eval(s));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> func = script.Context.GetFunc&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sum</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">8</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">30</span>, func(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h1>四、生成Lambda</h1>
<p>动态脚本除了执行计算结果，还可以生成Lambda，该功能可用于将脚本转化为LINQ。</p>
<p>示例：将动态脚本条件语句转化为LINQ查询条件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> whereCondition = script.Lambda&lt;Person, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p.Name=='tom' || p.Name=='jim'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">p</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> IQueryable&lt;Person&gt; query =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ...;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> query.Where(p =&gt; p.Name=="tom" || p.Name=="jim")</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> list = query.Where(whereCondition).ToList();</pre>
</div>
<h1>五、生成委托</h1>
<p>将脚本编译生成委托，然后在程序调用执行，也是一个常用场景。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> script = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Script();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> sum = script.Compile&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a+b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">b</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">3</span> Assert.AreEqual(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, sum(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>));</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>怎么样，有没有你想要的功能呢？欢迎一起交流学习！</p>
